title: Waterfront A2: The west beach terrace, redrafted
request:
Redraft the tale for Waterfront A2 (The west beach terrace). Two earlier versions are source material: use any of their facts and jokes, copy neither whole.
- Prototype 7.13 (Farsight's voice; Farsight must not appear): The valley began here: a cliff, an avenue, and a beach of sand brought from three provinces. The ceremony is being prepared in the circus. Place a cone. Farsight would like one more clean reading before the speeches.
- Prototype 8.1 (Dummy Corporation): The west beach terrace was laid with sand from three provinces, for clients you will one day serve. Place a cone and meet the car that reacts to it; every write-off here serves them.
Choose the length the tile needs, 15 to 35 words in at most two sentences: short when one image carries it, longer when the place has a history worth telling. Name the place, keep the duty and any equipment the tile issues, and point the place at the training.
